name: tabs
summary: The keyboard half of a tablist: arrows, Home and End move selection and focus together.

aria-orientation.doc: vertical makes ↑↓ drive the tabs instead of ←→.

list.doc: The tablist the keys are heard on; the host when there is none.

data-tab.doc: The tab's name, what current holds when it is selected.

current.doc: The selected tab's name; the first tab unless the page chose one.

select.doc: Selects a tab without moving focus.

next.doc: Selects and focuses the next tab, wrapping.

previous.doc: Selects and focuses the previous tab, wrapping.

first.doc: Selects and focuses the first tab.

last.doc: Selects and focuses the last tab.
